name: qwen3-rerank
description: text-embedding-v4 is the text embedding model in Alibaba Cloud's Qwen3-Embedding series, converting text into dense vectors. It supports 100+ mainstream languages and multiple programming languages, with selectable output dimensions from 64 to 2048, suitable for semantic search, recommendation, clustering, and classification.
zhDescription: text-embedding-v4 是阿里云通义 Qwen3-Embedding 系列的文本嵌入模型，可将文本转为稠密向量；支持 100+ 主流语种与多种编程语言，输出维度在 64–2048 间灵活可选，适用于语义检索、推荐、聚类、分类等下游任务。
longDescription: text-embedding-v4 is the text embedding model in Alibaba Cloud's Qwen3-Embedding series, converting text into dense vectors. modelParameters.label: Max Tokens
modelParameters.description: 单次生成的最大 token 数量

modelParameters.label: Frequency Penalty
modelParameters.description: 频率惩罚，减少重复内容的生成

modelParameters.label: Context Length
modelParameters.description: 支持的最大上下文长度
